args: rdi = first argument object (saved, thread-accounting identity)
rcx = early-stop flag-byte pointer (set to 1 on NULL item or predicate divert)
r8 = iteration count bound (loop exits when spliced count reaches it; 0 means return 0 immediately)
r9 = entry-slot pointer (chain head slot each built entry is spliced into)
stack argument = completion-byte pointer (always set to 1 at the epilogue)
function.key: each iteration consumes one class minimum exactly like the single-shot caller (fetch, class search, take, stamp, value, build, predicate/wake, give-back) and additionally splices the built entry into the entry-slot chain; return value is the spliced-iteration count
function.name: lu loop caller (count-bounded class-minimum consumer)
function.returns: spliced-iteration count in rax (== count on full completion, fewer on early exit); the rcx flag byte is set to 1 on NULL-item or predicate-divert early exit; the stack completion byte is set to 1 on every epilogue path
